scope: single-user, bounded, zero-unit OpenRouter route; no paid fallback

groq.reason: The configured account's free allowance and remaining capacity were not independently attested; no allowance probe was sent.

boundedRunPolicy.workspace: temporary isolated fixture only; hidden verifier materialized after the model stops

receipts.finding: An 8000-token harness setting left no repository capacity after fixed system, tool-schema, output, and safety reservations. The harness was changed to reject settings below 12000 before provider dispatch.

The first streamed response and tool loop worked; concatenated tool JSON reached the follow-up provider transcript and yielded HTTP 400. AgentRuntime now canonicalizes a bounded first JSON object for both execution and transcript continuity.

Actual runtime completed, made three successful tool calls, and changed src/math.js. The hidden verifier was initially placed at the wrong fixture-relative path; the harness was corrected before the next run.

All four provider requests returned HTTP 200; four tool calls succeeded; visible and hidden verification passed after src/math.js changed. The AgentRuntime correctly returned blocked with AGENT_MODEL_TURN_LIMIT before a final completion turn.

proves: The selected OpenRouter route was catalog-declared verified-free at dispatch time and had no configured paid fallback.
